note: Triennial election of the 16 electoral divisions of Clogher rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There was no contest: eleven Unionists and five Nationalists were nominated (Ulster Herald, 21 May 1949, p. 5, which names the five new members). All sixteen members are recorded; the eleven others come from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result, dated 23 May 1949 (Impartial Reporter, 26 May 1949, p. 8). Printed 'Aghintain'. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Aughentaine' to Aghintain (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Clogher Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Aghintain; the rounds were filed as Aughentaine (1899, 1902, 1905, 1908, 1911, 1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964, 1967); Aughentain (1924). This round was filed as 'Aughentaine', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (aughentaine) answers with a redirect to this one.
